name: Valor Estate Ltd (ex-DB Realty)
tagline: Mumbai real-estate developer (~Rs 5,600 Cr market cap) with a large land bank and marquee JV partners (Adani, Godrej, L&T, Lodha, Prestige) but negative ROCE and no durable moat - fundamentals don't yet support a re-rating thesis.
business_overview: Valor Estate (NSE: DBREALTY, formerly D B Realty, renamed March 2024) is a Mumbai-focused real-estate developer with a claimed 100M+ sq ft land-bank/project pipeline, monetising it via JVs with Adani Properties/Adani GoodHomes (incl. the Ten BKC redevelopment near Bandra Kurla Complex), Godrej Properties, L&T Realty, Lodha and Prestige. Promoters Vinod Goenka and Shahid Balwa retain control; both were acquitted by the CBI Special Court in the 2G spectrum case, a legacy overhang that is now resolved rather than active. Seeded via untrusted X triage (@rdkriplani, bullish, very-high conviction, 2026-09-13).

fundamentals_narrative: The bull case rests on land-bank monetisation optionality (JVs with top-tier developers, Ten BKC redevelopment) rather than current operating profitability - ROCE is effectively nil/negative and ROE is weak, so the core business is not yet generating returns that would justify the market cap on fundamentals alone. The 2G-case overhang on the promoters has been resolved (CBI Special Court acquittal), removing what was historically the company's most cited red flag, but this pass found no verified going-concern, pledge-spike, or auditor-resignation issue either - it is a genuine turnaround/optionality story, not currently a red-flag exclusion.
